query.window: 2000 most recent open items (868 issues, created 2025-01-04 to 2026-11-24; pull requests dropped)
query.media_filter: issue body links a GitHub-hosted video (user-attachments asset or legacy githubusercontent .mp4/.mov/.webm/.gif) that is not embedded as an image; 71 links on 68 issues, all video/mp4, video/quicktime or video/webm

status_set.no_usable_media: media missing, unreachable, unreadable, or outside 50 MB / 120 s
status_set.unsupported_device: needs a device, input method or browser Foley does not drive (mobile, tablet, pen, touchpad gesture, IME, Firefox-only, macOS-only)
status_set.excluded_sensitive_or_security: security report, or the recording shows personal data
status_set.eligible_not_attempted: ordinary desktop UI bug with usable media; not yet run
status_set.attempted_miss: run by Foley; failure not observed or proof not reached
status_set.failure_observed: run by Foley; failure predicate observed on the target build
status_set.proof_verified: run by Foley; failing test verified

scope_exclusions.note: Issues with video that are not bug reports on the open-source app are left out of the census rows.

media_review: Three frames (15%, 50%, 85%) of every census clip were inspected on 2026-11-24 for personal data and security content.
